_note: Bot dialogue templates per personality (F-153). {name} = the other player, {res} = resources asked for. Every personality has every line, so tone differs per personality.

greet: Speak fast. My axes are restless.
You again? Say what you want.
accept: Fine. Don't make me regret it.
counter: Not enough. Double it and we talk.
proposeAlliance: Fight beside me and we crush them all.
tribute: Pay {res} or I burn your fields.
tributeRefused: Then we settle this with steel.
helpRequest: They're at my walls! Bring your army!
betray: You were weak. I am not.

greet: Welcome, friend. Let's keep the peace.
Hello! I hope your harvest is good.
accept: Gladly. Trade makes us both stronger.
decline: I'm sorry, I can't spare that.
proposeAlliance: Shall we stand together? Nobody attacks a united front.
tribute: We are poor this season; could you share {res}?
helpRequest: Please, friend, we are attacked! Send help!
helpReply: Of course! Help is on the way.
betray: Forgive me. I had no other choice.
war: You leave me no choice. We will defend ourselves.
reply: That's kind of you to say.

greet: Greetings! What can I sell you today?
decline: No profit in that for me.
counter: Make it a little sweeter and it's yours.
proposeAlliance: An alliance is good for business. Interested?
tribute: A small fee of {res} keeps our roads safe for you.
tributeRefused: Your loss. My prices just went up.
helpRequest: My caravans are under attack! Our deal needs you!
helpReply: Protecting a partner is good business. Coming.
war: You've ruined a perfectly good market.

greet: How... interesting to hear from you.
I was just thinking about you.
counter: I have a better idea for us both.
proposeAlliance: Let us be friends. Close friends.
tribute: It would be a shame if something happened to your granary. {res} should prevent it.
tributeRefused: We'll see how long your luck holds.
helpRequest: My dear ally, I find myself in a spot of trouble.
helpReply: Naturally. I'll... see what I can do.
betray: Did you really think I was your friend?
liePeace: Peace, of course. You have my word.

greet: The land is wide, but not wide enough.
decline: No, I need that for my settlers.
counter: Throw in a bit more and it's done.
proposeAlliance: Together we could claim the whole continent.
tribute: Your border is in my way. Pay {res} and I'll look elsewhere.
tributeRefused: Then I'll take the land instead.
helpRequest: My new towns are under attack! Help me hold them!
betray: I need your land more than your friendship.

greet: State your business at our walls.
accept: Agreed. Our walls stand with you.
proposeAlliance: A shield wall needs many shields. Join us.
tribute: Our walls protect you too. Contribute {res}.
tributeRefused: Then you're on your own out there.
helpRequest: Our walls are breached! Allies, to us!
betray: Our walls keep only our own safe.
war: Come then. Break yourselves on our walls.

decline: Why trade when I can take?
counter: Sweeten it, or my riders visit you.
proposeAlliance: Ride with me. Plenty of loot for two.
tribute: Pay {res} and my riders stay home.
helpRequest: Get over here, they're on my tail!
betray: Your stores look too tasty to leave alone.
